observations.element: + Add conditions -> danh sach option nguon
observations.observed_result: Voi ca 35 layer da co Option Title rieng, chi 8 data-type xuat hien: toggle, additional-option, addon-charge, json-list, font, vector-category, clipart-category, group-clipart-categories. 27 type con lai khong xuat hien (bao gom color, vector-upload, va toan bo layer text/maps/puzzle/photo).
Chi 2 dang: toggle -> khong co toan tu, dung <select id='toggle'> gia tri true|On / false|Off. 7 type con lai -> 'is any of:' voi control multi-value. Khong co is-none-of / contains / so sanh.
Option nguon da dung o condition truoc bi loai khoi dropdown cua condition sau. Layer dang cau hinh khong tro vao chinh no. Voi clipart-category, clipart dau tien duoc tick san.

Chi layer dich co key 'dependency'; 34 layer con lai khong co key nay (vang mat, khong phai null). Shape: {match_type, dependencies[{element, value}], show_by_default}. 'element' = layer id cua layer nguon. Khong co key toan tu trong JSON.
